_purpose: Single source of truth for component versions across the system. The dashboard reads from the embedded copy of this; tools/version_bump.py is the only sanctioned writer. Versions display in: the dashboard top banner pill, the Creator's Log sysinfo grid, the backup-file naming convention, and saga round entries. Synchronizing them used to be manual and got forgotten ~10 times since 2026-06-13 — this file fixes that.
bump_policy: Increment when a Pass/Round lands that warrants a rollback point. Dashboard minor bumps per Pass (substantive UI or data architecture change). Brain minor bumps per protocol/discipline/tool-surface change. Major bumps reserved for paradigm shifts (e.g., a new tile kind, a new memory architecture).
backup_convention: dashboard-v{dashboard}-{date}.html and brain-v{brain}-{date}.md. The version_bump tool writes to versions.json which the dashboard reads on load. Manual backup files should mirror the version current at time of backup.
